deviations: Matched event-study sample (Table 1 Panel B cols 3 and 5): each station automated 2013-01-01 (242) is matched to its nearest station automated 2014-01-01 (123 candidates) by great-circle distance, with replacement; the paired sample stacks each treated station with a copy of its matched control (231,990 obs). The paper reports 186,499 obs for this sample; none of the variants tried in exploration (haversine vs Euclidean distance, 242 vs 218 treated stations, repeated vs unique controls, pair-days observed for both) reproduced that count, so the paper's exact matched-sample construction is not known and these two quantities may differ from it.

Deadline sample defined by automation date (stations automated on 2013-01-01 or 2014-01-01, 73 cities with data), which gives the paper's 242 treated / 123 control stations in Panel B and its Panel A col 5 daily N; the paper's text says 84 deadline cities.

City-level automation date for the city-month search RD: 15 cities have stations with different automation dates in station_list; the date shared by most of the city's stations is used (ties -> earliest).

rdrobust (R) with masspoints='off', cluster=city (vce cr1), triangular kernel, mserd bandwidth; conventional point estimate reported. The mass-point adjustment was turned off because the paper's reported bandwidths and in-bandwidth N (109/263 days; 91,470/232,326 obs) are reproduced exactly only without it (consistent with an older Stata rdrobust).
notes: Independent blind reproduction. Station-day sample = PM10 and all four weather variables non-missing (1,049,325 obs, as in the paper's Table 1 note). Residualized RDs: OLS of the outcome on station (or city) FE, calendar-month FE and temperature, RH, precipitation, wind speed over the full sample, then local linear RD on residuals; running variable days (PM10) or months from the automation month (AOD, searches). AOD and weather are station-month averages; Baidu indices are city-month means of daily indices for the 123 sample cities, with city-month weather averaged over the city's stations (8,661 mask / 8,590 filter obs, matching the paper's note). Event study: deadline stations, 2012-01-01..2013-12-31, treated x bins (7-12, 5-6, 3-4 months before; 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-12 after; 1-2 before omitted), station FE + month FE or year-month FE, weather controls, SEs clustered by city (fixest). Panel A in-bandwidth Ns for cols 1-5 and AOD col 2 and the search sample sizes equal the paper's reported Ns; these sample sizes and bandwidths (method information printed in the paper) were used as diagnostics for the sample definitions and the rdrobust settings, not to tune toward any withheld estimate. Attempts 1-3 and 7 were exploratory (no RESULT lines). Attempts 4 and 5 were exploratory runs that crashed (missing merge key; residual length mismatch) and were repaired. Attempt 6 was exploratory and crashed only in a trailing diagnostic print after all needed output had been printed; it was not repaired, so kind is "". Attempt 8 was the first run of the scored script and crashed on a duplicate-city assertion before printing any RESULT line; it was repaired for the final run. No run hung. Final run took about 14 s in the sandbox.
